eyebrow: SOQL & Salesforce Data Management · Chapter Two
subtitle: Lesson 8 · SOQL Aggregation & Grouping

code:
SELECT StageName,
       COUNT(Id) deals,
       SUM(Amount) pipeline
FROM Opportunity
GROUP BY StageName

-- every plain field: in GROUP BY
caption: Same rule as T-SQL: aggregate it or group by it.

code:
SELECT Industry,
       COUNT(Id) accounts,
       AVG(AnnualRevenue) avgRevenue
FROM Account
WHERE AnnualRevenue != null
GROUP BY Industry
ORDER BY COUNT(Id) DESC
caption: WHERE filters rows; ORDER BY repeats the aggregate.

code:
SELECT StageName,
       Account.Industry,
       COUNT(Id) deals
FROM Opportunity
GROUP BY StageName,
         Account.Industry
caption: One row per unique combination.
